skills.name: corezoid
skills.description: Corezoid basics: platform model, .conv.json, nodes, MCP tools, validation. Use for any Corezoid task that no narrower corezoid-* skill covers.

skills.name: corezoid-access
skills.description: Share processes, folders, stages, projects; groups, API-key users, invites, access audit. Triggers: "share", "доступ", "пошарь", "create API key".

skills.name: corezoid-alias-manager
skills.description: Process aliases (short_name, conv[@alias]): create, list, modify, delete, link; callback hash / Direct URL. Triggers: "alias", "алиас".

skills.name: corezoid-api-connector
skills.description: Build a process that calls the Corezoid public API (/api/2/json). Run only via /corezoid-api-connector; for Corezoid API connectors use corezoid-connector-create.

skills.name: corezoid-connector-create
skills.description: Atomic connector process for ONE endpoint of any HTTP API (Corezoid /api/2/json too), from docs or OpenAPI. Triggers: "connector", "коннектор", "інтеграція з". Not multi-step.

skills.name: corezoid-create
skills.description: Create a new process from scratch. Triggers: "create a process", "new process", "создай процесс". One-endpoint connectors: corezoid-connector-create.

skills.name: corezoid-dashboard-manager
skills.description: Dashboards and charts bound to process nodes, real-time, drill-down. Triggers: "dashboard", "chart", "дашборд", process metrics.

skills.name: corezoid-describe
skills.description: Set the short description of a process, folder or project without changing logic. Triggers: "add description", "обнови описание".

skills.name: corezoid-edit
skills.description: Modify an existing process: add/remove nodes, change logic, fix errors. Triggers: "edit process", "fix", "add a node", "поправь процесс".

skills.name: corezoid-edit-bot
skills.description: Edit or fix a bot built by corezoid-gen-bot: commands, copy, keyboards, languages, wiring, deploy. Triggers: "измени бота", "бот не отвечает".

skills.name: corezoid-feedback
skills.description: Report plugin bugs/ideas to the Corezoid team. After a platform mistake (wrong node type or MCP tool, Simulator vs Corezoid API) offer it in one line; not for business logic.

skills.name: corezoid-gen-bot
skills.description: Messenger bot (Telegram, Viber, Apple, FB) over existing processes. Triggers: "сгенерируй бота", "bot from processes"; "погнали"/"execute plan" in .corezoid-gen-bot/.

skills.name: corezoid-git-context
skills.description: Update _ext/docs/*.md in the git mirror after a session with real deploys or decisions. Triggers: "save context", "збережи контекст".

skills.name: corezoid-gitcall
skills.description: Git Call node: custom code (Python, Go, JS, PHP, Java, Dockerfile) as a process step. Triggers: "git call", "run my code", git_call push hangs.

skills.name: corezoid-init
skills.description: Connect to Corezoid: login (OAuth or API key), workspace and stage, project pull. Triggers: "init", "setup", "login", "connect to corezoid".

skills.name: corezoid-lifecycle
skills.description: Pause, resume or move processes and folders, only on explicit request. Triggers: "pause/resume process", "move process/folder", "поставь на паузу", "перемести процесс".

skills.name: corezoid-node-layout
skills.description: Auto-arrange node x/y before pushing a process you built, or when asked to arrange nodes or fix overlaps. Never re-layout user-positioned ones.

skills.name: corezoid-process-optimizer
skills.description: Optimize a process: fewer tacts, merged nodes, data flow, resilience, Code → Condition + Set Parameters. Triggers: "optimize", "improve", "clean up process".

skills.name: corezoid-process-tech-writer
skills.description: Document a process: Markdown doc plus JSON with node and parameter descriptions. Triggers: "document this process", "задокументируй".

skills.name: corezoid-project-review
skills.description: Audit a whole project or folder across processes. Triggers: "review project", "audit folder", "ревью проекта".

skills.name: corezoid-retro
skills.description: End-of-session retrospective: route learnings to CLAUDE.md, team feedback, permissions or memory. Triggers: "retro", "ретро", "что мы узнали".

skills.name: corezoid-review
skills.description: Review one process: issues, hardcoded values, what it does. Triggers: "review process", "audit", "what's wrong with", "проверь процесс".

skills.name: corezoid-state-diagram-create
skills.description: New state diagram (conv_type "state"): state machine, status store by ref. Triggers: "state diagram", "стейт диаграмма", "track status".

skills.name: corezoid-state-diagram-edit
skills.description: Modify a state diagram: states, transitions, side effects, api_callback wiring. Triggers: "edit state diagram", "add a state".

skills.name: corezoid-variable-manager
skills.description: Env variables (env_var) for URLs, tokens, API keys, secrets: create, list, modify, delete. Triggers: "env var", "variable", "secret", "переменная".

skills.name: marketplace-publish-validation
skills.description: Pre-publication check of a project or folder for the Corezoid marketplace. Triggers: "publish to marketplace", "можна публікувати".
